preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(A, int) and isinstance(B, int) and isinstance(C, int) and 0 <= A <= 1000000 and 0 <= B <= 1000000 and 0 <= C <= 1000000 and (A + B + C) >= 1 for A, B, C in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, A, B, and C are non-negative integers up to 1,000,000, and their sum is at least 1.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['YES', 'NO'] for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((line == 'YES') == (total_sum % 2 == 0 and can_partition(A, B, C, total_sum // 2)) for line, (A, B, C) in zip(output_lines, test_cases) if (total_sum := A + 2*B + 3*C) % 2 == 0 or True)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if the total sum of the multiset is even and there exists a subset of the multiset summing to exactly half the total sum; otherwise it is 'NO'.
